meta.description: Where newcomers make new friends at furmeets and furry conventions. By Global Furry Television.
site.name: GFTV HelloSpot
official.line: An official Global Furry Television website
official.domain-heading: Official GFTV websites end in globalfurry.tv or gftv.asia
official.domain-body: Read the address from the end, at the last period before the first single slash. A website ending in anything else is not GFTV, even if the name shows up earlier in the address.
official.trusted-link: The full list of official GFTV websites
official.secure-body: Look for a lock icon, or https:// at the beginning of the address. Only share personal information on an official website over a secure connection.

hero.title: You found a HelloSpot!
hero.lede: At furmeets and furry conventions, a HelloSpot is where newcomers go to make new friends.
how.title: How a HelloSpot works
how.spot.title: Spot the smile
how.spot.body: Look for the HelloSmile on a card, a lanyard or a sign. Wherever you see it, that's a HelloSpot.
how.hello.title: Say hello
how.hello.body: Come on over and say hi. Nobody at a HelloSpot expects you to know anyone yet.
how.friend.title: Make a friend
how.friend.body: Get to know the people around you, and leave with someone to look for at the next meet.

about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) is the biggest furry fandom news channel in Asia, headquartered in Singapore.
about.body-2: We showcase the growth of the furry community for everyone to appreciate, today and tomorrow, and we create spaces where people can learn about and understand one another.
about.body-3: Reaching across major continents from our home base, GFTV's team is international, multicultural and multilingual.
